call.text: The decoder stack inserts a third sub‑layer that performs multi‑head attention over the encoder output, while each encoder layer has only the two sub‑layers of self‑attention and feed‑forward network [AIAYN:3.1:c009]. In the decoder, the self‑attention sub‑layer is masked so that positions cannot attend to subsequent positions, preserving the auto‑regressive property [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. Encoder‑decoder attention uses queries that come from the previous decoder layer, and the keys and values come from the encoder’s output [AIAYN:3.2.3:c016]. The retrieved passages do not state how the decoder combines these attended representations with its own feed‑forward sub‑layer.
